address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x0C`.

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*

drdy_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Data-ready pin. Often labelled `INT`. Using this pin might lead to slightly quicker read times.

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*

filter.docs:
**int**: On-chip digital filter. Defaults to `6`. Must be between `0` and `7`.

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*

hallconf.docs:
**int**: Modifies the hall plate spinning (2-phase vs 4-phase). Defaults to `0xC`. Must be `0xC` or `0x0`.

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [I²C Component](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) if you want to use multiple I²C buses.

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*

oversampling.docs:
**int**: On-chip oversampling. Defaults to `2`. Must be between `0` and `3`.

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*

**int**: On-chip oversampling for the temperature sensor. Defaults to `0`. Must be between `0` and `3`.

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*

temperature_compensation.docs:
**bool**: On-chip temperature compensation. Defaults to `false`. When enabled, the resolution options `DIV_8` and `DIV_4` cannot be used.

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [MLX90393 Triple-axis Magnetometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mlx90393#configuration-variables)*
